FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: Inspection inquiries may be directed to the Market Manager, Sarah Thompson, at (555) 123-4567.
FIELDS.GL CODE: GL CODE for Food Retail Operations with Safety Compliance
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Fresh Picks Market, we specialize in providing a diverse selection of fresh fruits and vegetables sourced from local farms and suppliers with rigorous food safety certifications. Our operations emphasize quality, with a focus on maintaining optimal temperature and humidity controls for all perishable inventory to prevent spoilage. We conduct regular supplier audits to ensure compliance with food safety regulations, and all staff undergo documented training in food handling practices to mitigate the risk of foodborne illness. Our market is committed to adhering to local health department regulations and maintaining current certifications, assuring our customers of the highest food safety standards.

Our market regularly conducts quality control checks and sells produce that may have previously received alerts regarding food safety standards, ensuring our customers get a variety of fresh options.

FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Fresh Picks Market has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the prior three years. They maintain compliance with food safety standards and regulations, which supports their insurance eligibility.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Fresh Picks Market does not lease employees to or from other employers. The operations are managed internally without outsourcing staffing.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – Coverage is restricted for markets with unresolved or repeated food safety violations, which impacts eligibility for workers' compensation insurance.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Fresh Picks Market does not own or operate any other business. All operations are focused solely on retailing fresh fruits and vegetables.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Fresh Picks Market does not have any other insurance policies with this company. The market maintains a focus on compliance with food safety standards and eligibility requirements.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Fresh Picks Market is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Their operations focus solely on the retail of fresh fruits and vegetables.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Fresh Picks Market does not rent or loan equipment to others, and coverage is restricted for markets with unresolved or repeated food safety violations.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Fresh Picks Market has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years. The market maintains strong financial practices and compliance.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Fresh Picks Market does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals. Their operations focus exclusively on the retail of fresh fruits and vegetables without engaging in such activities.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Fresh Picks Market does not have any catastrophe exposure that would affect coverage eligibility. The focus of the market is solely on the retail of fresh fruits and vegetables, with no operations involved in high-risk activities.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Fresh Picks Market has not experienced any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Fresh Picks Market does not have any uncorrected fire code violations; however, coverage is restricted due to ongoing issues with food safety compliance.
